title: [main] Calculate Inventory - Add check to skip report processing if Warehouse Entry table is empty
summary: The Calculate Inventory report now skips processing iterations when the Warehouse Entry table contains no records, improving performance for environments without warehouse functionality.
key_points: Added early exit condition when Warehouse Entry table is empty
Prevents unnecessary iterations through the report processing loop
Reduces processing overhead in standard inventory counting scenarios
Applied to both base application layers
quote: Stop processing "Warehouse Entry" in each iteration when it is completely empty
